**Finding: RENEWAL — compliant (sits at fallback).**

Paragraph 18.1 gives a single 25-year initial period measured from the RFS Date, after which the Agreement simply "continue[s] in operation" and is "terminable thereafter by agreement of the Parties." There is no automatic renewal into fixed further terms and no renewal-linked price-escalation mechanic anywhere in the Agreement — targeted searches for renewal, notice-window and price-increase language surfaced only meeting notices (3.x), amendment notices (p0265) and design-capacity expansion costs (14.1), none of which is a renewal uplift.

Because both fallback elements are conditional on an automatic-renewal trigger that does not exist, there is no notice window to shorten and no uplift to cap. The one (1) year's prior notice in 18.1 is a standing unilateral withdrawal right available to each Party, including us, at the end of the Initial Period or any time thereafter — it benefits our side and is governed by the termination provisions (18.2–18.4 and the asset-realisation mechanics), so it is neither a >90-day non-renewal window nor a term to flag twice. No redline proposed.
